description: Historical rate time-series: a date-ranged array of {date, min/median/max APR, count} points per product/state for dashboards, charts, backtests, and timing confidence — bounded by data retention. Differs from get_rate_delta (a single now-vs-then comparison): this returns the full series. Boats, RVs, motorcycles, and powersports are first-class product types; auto_loan means cars. Calls the /v1/rate-history public API (single source of truth).

state.description: US state code (2-letter, e.g., CA, TX). Required.

vehicle_condition.description: auto_loan only; selects the benchmark bucket. Default "new".

window.description: Lookback window. Default "90d". Bounded by data retention.

name: get_rate_history

data_source.description: Internal backing store that served this query ('clickhouse'); operational detail, not something to report to the user.

interval.description: Bucket size the series is aggregated into, e.g. 'week', 'day', or 'month'. Each entry in `series` covers one of these.

note.description: Coverage caveat for this series, notably how many buckets are empty because history is retention-bounded. Do not describe empty buckets as rates falling to zero.

product_type.description: Loan or deposit category this result covers, e.g. 'mortgage', 'auto_loan', 'heloc', 'savings'.

series.description: One bucket per interval across the window, oldest first. Buckets with no scrapes are present with null statistics.

count.description: Number of rate observations in this bucket. 0 means the bucket is empty and its statistics are null.

date.description: Start date of this bucket (ISO date). For weekly intervals this is the week's first day.

max.description: Highest APR in percent observed in this bucket. Null when the bucket has no observations.

median.description: Median APR in percent for this bucket, the value to plot as the trend line. Null when the bucket has no observations.

min.description: Lowest APR in percent observed in this bucket. Null when no rates were captured in the bucket — a data gap, not a rate of zero.

state.description: Two-letter US state code the result is scoped to (e.g. 'CA'). Null means the result was not filtered by state.

summary.description: Start-to-end comparison across the populated portion of the series.

as_of.description: Timestamp of the most recent underlying rate observation.

direction.description: Direction of the move across the window: 'up', 'down', or 'flat'.

first.description: Earliest populated bucket, with its date and median APR in percent.

last.description: Most recent populated bucket, with its date and median APR in percent.

median_delta_pct.description: Change in median APR from first to last populated bucket, in percentage points (0.215 = 21.5 basis points). Negative means rates fell.

points.description: Number of populated buckets the summary is based on; a handful of points is a weak trend.

window.description: Lookback period used for the comparison, expressed as a short duration string such as '4w', '90d', or '180d'.
